column1: # dev-model model inventory — curated MLX (Apple Silicon) models for local dev/analysis.
# Pipe-delimited: id | tier | tags | note        (lines starting with # are ignored)
# CURATED FOR A 64 GB MAC — you can realistically give ~40 GB to weights, so
# nothing here needs more. tier = rough RAM class:
#   s  < 8 GB    — instant; great for parallel/quick edits
#   m  ~12-20 GB — daily driver; comfortable on 64 GB
#   l  ~30-35 GB — tight on 64 GB (raise iogpu.wired_limit_mb, close apps, less context)
# tags: agentic = has a native mlx_lm tool-call parser (MCP/tool-use ready);
#       coder | reasoning | general | fast | default (the served default).
# Excluded — won't run (well) on 64 GB, need 96-128 GB: gpt-oss-120b (~63 GB)
mlx-community/Devstral-Small-2-24B-Instruct-2512-4bit|m|coder,agentic,default|Newest Devstral (Dec-2025); mistral tool parser — top agentic coder for harnesses
